verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is documented as running untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs, which is hardware-virtualized isolation, and the docs describe these environments as ephemeral, which covers the disposable part. The evidence is only short first-party summary lines. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the isolation mechanism and sandbox lifecycle/API (create, destroy, limits), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes
